title: Fotografía de Producto Still Life: Colección de Lentes de Cámara Vintage
prompt:
**Prompt:**
A still life product photograph of a collection of vintage SLR camera lenses arranged on a plain, seamless light beige studio background. Various black lenses, including brands like Sigma and Quantaray with visible focal length markings (e.g., 28-80mm) and lens caps, are grouped together. Soft, diffused studio lighting highlights the textures of the plastic barrels, rubber grip rings, and the glass elements. Shallow depth of field, focusing on the central lenses.
